items.title: Ukraine's energy facilities hit 18 times in past 24 hours – energy minister

items.teaser: In addition to Kyiv, 12 regions of Ukraine came under attack overnight.

items.title: Three injured in Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
items.teaser: Enemy shelling and drone strikes target civilian infrastructure, educational facilities and housing across Nikopol and surrounding Dnipropetrovsk districts.

items.title: Ukraine's ground drones complete over 30,000 missions in record month for robot warfare
items.teaser: The October mission count, which includes logistics and evacuation missions, is over four times higher than the 7,511 missions recorded in January 2026.

items.title: NATO's secretary general does not think war in Ukraine will end with victory for either side
items.teaser: NATO's Mark Rutte has called for continued European vigilance, warning that a post-war Russian military poses long-term security threats despite potential peace deals.

items.title: Mala Tokmachka remains under Ukrainian control – military
items.teaser: Mala Tokmachka in the Zaporizhzhia region remains under the control of the Ukrainian Defense Forces, despite repeated claims by the Russian military command that it has allegedly captured the settlement.

items.title: Russia steps up attacks on Izium, likely seeking to disrupt Ukrainian logistics along two front-line directions, ISW says
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Izium at least seven times over a seven-day period between 29 October and 4 November.

items.title: Hungary’s last communist-era premier says he saw reports on fellow soldiers’ politics and sexuality attributed to young Orbán, who denies it
items.teaser: The premier, Miklós Németh, says he returned the papers in 1990, and journalist Szabolcs Panyi writes they may have vanished with a KGB-trained spy chief’s files.

items.title: Russia promised Trump diesel. Five of its tankers turned for Brazil, Africa, and the Mediterranean instead
items.teaser: Part of the fuel announced as relief for US prices before the vote is now looking for buyers far from American ports.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages warehouse complex, house in Kyiv region, injures man
items.teaser: A 22-year-old man was injured in a Russian drone attack in the Kyiv region and taken to hospital.

items.title: Head of Zelenskyy's office says upcoming negotiations will not be final
items.teaser: Head of Ukraine's Presidential Office Kyrylo Budanov manages expectations ahead of face-to-face negotiations with Russian and US delegations in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: About nine million abroad, millions under occupation, soldiers at the front: why Kyiv says the wartime vote Trump wants would be unfair

items.title: Durchsuchung bei mutmaßlichem Gründer rechtsradikaler Chatgruppe
items.teaser: Der Einsatz in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern steht nach NDR Informationen im Zusammenhang mit vereitelten mutmaßlichen Anschlagsplänen in Niedersachsen.

items.title: Prosecutor asks court to place SBU general Duka in custody with UAH 100M bail option
items.teaser: The prosecution has asked the High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) to order the detention of Major General of the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) Serhii Duka, with the option of posting bail of UAH 100 million.

items.title: Budanov to lead Ukrainian delegation at talks in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine Kyrylo Budanov will lead the Ukrainian delegation at talks in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates, on November 10-11.

items.title: Turkey complains Russian gas too expensive in possible discount bid
items.teaser: "This could also be a bargaining message to Moscow: offer a better price or lose more market share," Isaac Levi, an energy policy analyst with the Center for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: Fishing for drones: a Ukrainian box that fires nets at FPVs heads for serial production
items.teaser: Phantom Defense says ten units are already in combat trials, and Militarnyi watched the system work at a test range.

items.title: Ukrainian national from Netherlands delivers 10 vehicles to 3rd Army Corps
items.teaser: Musician Oleh Lysenko has delivered new medical and evacuation vehicles to soldiers of the 3rd Army Corps during an event at Kyiv's War Museum.

items.title: Marinesprecher: Russland steht vor Mangel an Flugabwehr
items.teaser: In der russischen Luftwaffe gibt es einen Mangel an Flugabwehrsystemen zum Schutz von militärischen Objekten, insbesondere von Flugplätzen, sagte der Sprecher der Marine, Dmytro Pletentschuk im ukrainischen Fernsehen.

items.title: Ukraine to resume medical air evacuation flights by year-end, PM says
items.teaser: The government has approved regulations governing the flights, which will be used to transport patients, medical personnel, donor organs and equipment between hospitals, as well as to take patients abroad for treatment.

items.title: Lack of political will in US behind delays in Patriot missile supplies to Ukraine – Finnish defense minister
items.teaser: European allies have already paid for interceptor missiles for Patriot air defense systems, but Washington has yet to approve their delivery, as Ukraine prepares for new Russian attacks on its energy infrastructure.

items.title: Three injured in Russian aerial bomb attack on Sumy
items.teaser: Sumy Oblast official has reported three civilian injuries and infrastructure damage following Russian strikes using six guided aerial bombs across four locations.

items.title: Ukraine returns 13 children from Russian occupation, NGO says
items.teaser: The operation comes amid Russia's ongoing efforts to indoctrinate and militarize Ukrainian children living under occupation. The organization Save Ukraine says it has helped rescue more than 1,800 children from Russia and Russian-occupied Ukrainian territories.

items.title: Ukraine anti-trust regulator clears Uber’s takeover bid for food delivery Glovo service
items.teaser: The approval allows Uber to gain indirect control of Delivery Hero through its subsidiary, Uber International Technologies II Corporation, bringing Glovo's Ukrainian operations under Uber's control.

items.title: Ukraine just sent 28 armed robots at Russian lines with zero soldiers. Russia answered with robots of its own
items.teaser: The Russian drones won this time, and it won’t matter much: Ukraine is building ground robots by the tens of thousands, and the next 28 might get through.

items.title: Ukrainian forces carry out over 30,000 drone missions in single month for first time
items.teaser: Verified Delta combat data has revealed Ukrainian unmanned ground vehicles carried out 31,398 frontline supply and casualty evacuation tasks in October.

items.title: Russia faces shortage of air defense systems to protect military airfields – Ukrainian Navy
items.teaser: Russia is facing a shortage of air defense systems to protect military facilities, including airfields.

items.title: Ukraine to lose US$5.2bn in export revenues due to port blockade
items.teaser: The National Bank of Ukraine says the blockade will cost agriculture US$4.6 billion and ore exports US$0.6 billion in July-December 2026, with losses forecast to continue in 2027.

items.title: Selenskyj: Stromausfälle in mehreren Regionen, Lage in der Hauptstadt am schwierigsten
items.teaser: In Kyjiw ist die Sutuation mit Strom- und Wasserversorgung nach russischen Angriffen am schwierigsten. Eine der Ursachen seien Versäumnisse der Behörden der Hauptstadt bei der Vorbereitung auf den Winter, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Five houses damaged, woman injured by falling drone debris in Cherkasy region
items.teaser: In Korsun-Shevchenkivskyi, Cherkasy region, a drone attack damaged five residential houses and a power line. A woman suffered an acute stress reaction.

items.title: Midas case: HACC places 'Rocket' under house arrest after nearly a year in pretrial detention
items.teaser: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) has changed the preventive measure imposed on Ihor Myroniuk, a former advisor to the energy minister who is implicated in the Midas case under the nickname "Rocket," to round-the-clock house arrest.

items.title: Video message of President António Costa for the New Economy Forum
items.teaser: President of the European Council António Costa delivered a video message on the occasion of the New Economy Forum award, in which he highlighted the important role of the 2026 awarded Ibero-American General Secretariat in promoting multilateralism and international relations.

items.title: Drone-proof armored bulldozer “clears the way” for Ukrainian defenders of Kramatorsk
items.teaser: It's a dangerous, dirty job clearing wrecked vehicles from a strategic eastern highway. But the 100th Mechanized Brigade's engineers are up to it.

items.title: Grenzschutz dementiert Berichte über Massenflucht der Ukrainer vor hartem Winter
items.teaser: Der Grenzschutz stellt keine Zunahme der Zahl von Ukrainern, die aus Angst vor einem harten Winter die Ukraine verlassen, fest, sagte der Sprecher der Behörde, Andrij Demtschenko, im ukrainischen Fernsehen.

items.title: Czech arms makers set sights on space defense in bid to sustain Ukraine-driven arms boom

items.title: EU expands Ukraine sanctions push with new office and crypto task force

items.title: A report put words in his mouth, a Korean CEO says—he never told the magazine Ukraine dropped his AI
items.teaser: Newtype Industries contradicts a published account of Ukrainian officials allegedly shutting down its battlefield tests.

items.teaser: G7 foreign ministers will meet in Paris with Ukraine's Andrii Sybiha to discuss air defence, financial and energy support amid intensified Russian strikes.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte zerstören russische Militärlager in besetzten Gebieten
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben am 5. November und in der Nacht zum 6. November zwei Munitionslager der russischen Armee in der Region Saporischschja sowie eine Kontrollstelle für Drohnen und ein Treibstofflager in der Region Donezk getroffen.

items.title: Ukraine's Defense Ministry, Brave1 scale up EW-resistant group drone control technology
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Ministry and the Brave1 defense innovation cluster are working to scale up a technology for controlling groups of unmanned aerial vehicles that allows drones to remain resistant to enemy electronic warfare (EW) systems.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 1, injure 21 across Ukraine over past day as emergency power cuts hit 7 regions
items.teaser: The situation remains most difficult in Kyiv, where power limitations remain in place due to significant damage to energy infrastructure, the Energy Ministry said.

items.title: Russia destroyed 800,000 sq m of Ukraine's warehouse space in third quarter, says National Bank

items.title: Russian intelligence services recruiting Ukrainian refugees for sabotage operations in Europe – intelligence

items.title: US$330,000 bail posted for senior Ukrainian police official in Carthage case

items.teaser: Russian forces struck several energy facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region on the morning of November 6. The facilities had previously been targeted in Russian attacks.

items.title: Ukraine will resume air medical evacuations, cutting travel time severalfold, PM says
items.teaser: Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has said State Emergency Service aircraft will resume air medical evacuations, cutting patient transport times from 15 hours to two or three.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Komyschuwacha: 53 Leichen geborgen
items.teaser: In Dorf Komyschuwacha im Gebiet Saporischschja dauern Such- und Rettungsarbeiten nach einem russischen Luftangriff vom 2. November an. Bislang wurden 53 Leichen aus den Trümmern geborgen.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian ammunition depots in Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk regions
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck two Russian ammunition depots in the Zaporizhzhia region on November 5 and overnight into November 6, as well as an enemy drone command post and a fuel and lubricant depot in the Donetsk region.

items.teaser: Der US-Präsident hat in Washington einen Kreml-Berater empfangen. Donald Trumps anschließendes Statement dürfte für Unruhe in der Ukraine und Europa sorgen.

items.title: Bodies of 53 people recovered from rubble of underground school in Komyshuvakha
items.teaser: Search and rescue operations are continuing at the site of the November 2 airstrike in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. So far, rescuers have recovered the bodies of 53 people.

items.title: Finland defense minister calls for burden sharing on defense and Ukraine, for the sake of European unity
items.teaser: Finland's Defense Minister Antti Hakkanen said European countries should commit at least 0.25% of GDP in support of Ukraine, which Kyiv has identified as the right percentage to keep it financially afloat.

items.title: A Russian refinery rated at more than 6 million tons a year burns again in Krasnodar Krai

items.teaser: The death toll from the Russian attack on a school in the settlement of Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, on 2 November has risen to 53.

items.teaser: The number includes 2,440 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Zuerst überflog ein US-Spionageflugzeug den Suwalki-Korridor – danach umkreiste es die russische Exklave Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Ein US-Aufklärungsflugzeug hat erneut eine Mission nahe Kaliningrad geflogen. Die Artemis II überquerte dabei zweimal den Suwałki-Korridor.

items.title: 2440 Soldaten: Russlands Verluste seit gestern
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 601. 830 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 2440.

items.title: Russia drones attack five districts of Dnipropetrovsk region overnight
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out more than ten drone attacks against five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, causing damage to several locations.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure facility in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an energy infrastructure facility in the Mykolaiv region yesterday using a Geran-type attack drone.

items.title: Russian army loses 2,440 troops in war against Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: The total estimated combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 6, 2026, have reached approximately 1,601,830 personnel, including 2,440 troops lost over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 227 drones
items.teaser: Russia launched 227 attack drones overnight. Around 15 drones were still in the air as of 08:00.

items.title: Trump trifft Kreml-Vertreter und stellt Abkommen in Aussicht
items.teaser: Sowohl Vertreter Russlands als auch der Ukraine waren jetzt zu Gast im Weißen Haus. Doch den US-Präsidenten persönlich durfte nur der Kreml-Gesandte treffen. Anschließend kündigte Trump einen möglichen Deal an, nannte aber keine Details.

items.title: Zelensky outlines main topics of negotiations between teams in Brussels
items.teaser: Security guarantees for Ukraine and preparations for a trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi were the key topics of negotiations held in Brussels on November 4–5.

items.title: Ukraine to propose expanding Oleshky evacuation experience to other occupied territories in talks with U.S. and Russia – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine will propose to the United States and Russia that the evacuation efforts carried out in Oleshky be expanded to other occupied territories.

items.title: Trump stellt Ukraine-Abkommen mit Russland in Aussicht
items.teaser: Trump stellt Ukraine-Abkommen mit Russland in Aussicht

items.title: Canada to allocate $1.8B for drone procurement
items.teaser: Canada will spend at least CAD 2.3 billion (approximately $1.8 billion) on deploying advanced combat drones and counter-drone systems.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure facilities in Kyiv Oblast with jet-powered drones
items.teaser: Three jet-powered UAVs targeted the Bila Tserkva hromada overnight, disrupting electricity supplies as repair crews work to restore power.

items.title: Ukrainian citizen killed at hotel in Slovakia: Police open murder investigation
items.teaser: A Ukrainian citizen died from stab wounds at a hotel in the western Slovak city of Trenčín during the night of November 5. Another Ukrainian citizen has been detained on suspicion of committing the crime.

items.title: Russia loses 2,440 soldiers and 54 artillery systems over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,440 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Trump announces 'big deal' that concerns Ukraine and all of Europe
items.teaser: The U.S. president said that a major agreement could be reached in the near future, one that would concern not only Ukraine but Europe as a whole.

items.title: Ukrainian forces target oil refinery as explosions reported across southern Russia
items.teaser: A Russian oil refinery was set ablaze as a Ukrainian drone attack set off fires and explosions across southern Russia overnight on Nov. 6, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Afipsky oil refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai targeted in attack, fire breaks out – photos
items.teaser: Explosions were heard at one of southern Russia's largest refineries, with thick smoke later seen drifting towards Krasnodar. The attack has not been officially confirmed.

items.title: Defense Forces neutralize more than 90% of Russian Lancet and Molniya drones in one week
items.teaser: Russian forces deployed 7,947 Lancet and Molniya attack drones at the tactical level between October 29 and November 4. Ukraine's Defense Forces neutralized nearly 91% of them.

items.title: Prosecutor General's Office investigating deaths of 241 Ukrainians in Russian captivity
items.teaser: Law enforcement officials are investigating 241 cases of Ukrainians dying in Russian captivity. The dead include 230 prisoners of war and 11 civilians.

items.title: Trump meets Russian envoy in Washington ahead of Ukraine peace talks, claims 'big, beautiful agreement' coming
items.teaser: "There's going to be an agreement. It's going to be a big agreement, and it's going to involve more than Ukraine," U.S. President Donald Trump said.

items.title: Meloni urges EU to agree on representative for Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has called on the European Union to decide who will represent the bloc in negotiations on ending Russia's war against Ukraine and what mandate its representative will have.

items.title: Trump's envoy Kushner: US to hold peace talks with Ukraine and Russia next week
items.teaser: Jared Kushner says Washington has prepared proposals for discussions aimed at ending the war and establishing long-term security arrangements for Ukraine and Europe.

items.title: Ukrainian troops capture Russian soldier wearing Ukrainian military uniform
items.teaser: Operators of the 3rd Detachment of the 4th Ranger Regiment of the Special Operations Forces (SOF) captured a Russian serviceman who was disguised in a Ukrainian Armed Forces uniform.

items.title: Finland sentences Fitburg captain and boatswain to prison over damage to Gulf of Finland cables
items.teaser: The Helsinki District Court has sentenced the captain and boatswain of the vessel Fitburg to prison terms in connection with damage to undersea cables in the Gulf of Finland late last year.

items.title: Ukraine needs to consolidate 'bipartisan support' in US following midterm elections, Zelensky says
items.teaser: With Democrats set to control the U.S. Senate and House of Representatives come 2027, Zelensky said Ukraine now has "increased chances" of securing additional aid.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.teaser: Schnell zur passenden Förderung – erstmals ausschließlich digital verfügbar.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

items.title: Ausfuhrkontrolle: Bundesregierung vereinfacht Ausfuhr von bestimmten Rüstungsgütern an die Golfstaaten und die Ukraine
items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
items.teaser: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on the same day (6 November 2026) a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.

items.title: Trump raises prospect of 'big, beautiful' Russia-Ukraine deal
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump said the Ukraine war was close to being settled and that ending it might involve "all of Europe."

items.title: Clashes in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka: Police and Security Service identify 130 people who may be involved
items.teaser: The National Police of Ukraine and the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) have identified 130 people who may have been involved in the unrest in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka.

items.title: Russian vehicles can now shrug off cheap drones. Near Huliaipole, Ukrainian pilots are sending one they can’t
items.teaser: The 237th Unmanned Systems Battalion is aiming heavy drones, usually saved for targets far behind the front, at single armored vehicles, trading one expensive drone for a near-certain kill.

items.title: Could affect all of Europe: Trump announces major new deal involving Ukraine
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has hinted at an upcoming agreement extending beyond Ukraine, but has provided no details. His remarks followed a meeting with Vladimir Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev.

items.title: Kyiv plans to connect all residential buildings to heating by November 12
items.teaser: Heating supply to residential buildings in Kyiv began on November 2, and it will take 10 days to fully bring the heating system online.

items.title: Spain to provide Ukraine $490 million in military aid, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Attending the 30th Ibero-American Summit, Zelensky said the funds will help bolster Ukrainian air defenses as Russian strikes pummel Ukrainian transportation and energy infrastructure.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine must fight for $16B in suspended US aid
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky believes that following the U.S. elections, Ukraine should seek to secure $16 billion in aid from the United States that was previously suspended.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Spain will provide Ukraine with €437m military aid package
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced a new Spanish military aid package worth €437 million following talks with Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

items.title: Additional EUR 70B for Ukraine: Zelensky reports positive response from EU
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he had received a positive response to the proposal to allocate an additional EUR 70 billion to Ukraine for 2027 following his meeting with European Council President Antonio Costa.

items.title: Canadian service member faces court-martial for sharing sensitive information with Ukraine
items.teaser: Master Warrant Officer Matthew Robar of the Canadian Forces Intelligence Command is charged with passing operational information to Ukraine and will face a court-martial hearing in December.

items.title: Zelensky meets King Felipe VI of Spain
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with King Felipe VI of Spain and expressed his condolences over the deadly train collision in Toledo.

items.title: CoE commissioner calls strikes on school in Komyshuvakha war crime
items.teaser: Council of Europe Commissioner for Human Rights Michael O'Flaherty has condemned Russia's strike on a school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, and called for urgent increased support for Ukraine ahead of winter.

items.title: Russia attacked Ukraine's energy infrastructure 78 times over past three days – DTEK
items.teaser: Russian invaders have carried out 78 strikes on Ukraine's energy infrastructure over the past three days. They have targeted both power plants and electricity transmission facilities.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine needs Taurus missiles from Germany, and it would benefit both sides
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy argues that acquiring and testing German-made cruise missiles would help Ukraine strike Russian launch sites and give the manufacturer valuable battlefield experience.

items.title: ArcelorMittal beklagt Verluste in Höhe von 1,1 Milliarden Dollar wegen Stilllegung des Stahlwerks in Krywyj Rih
items.teaser: Die Stilllegung des Stahlwerks „ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih“ habe dem Konzern mehr als 1,1 Milliarden US-Dollar gekostet. Die Verluste im dritten Quartal 2026 betrugen 391 Millionen US-Dollar.

items.title: Over 600 hectares cleared of Russian forces: Ukraine's military intelligence reveals details of operation in Sumy region
items.teaser: During Operation Cheburechna, seven weeks of intense combat operations in autumn 2026 saw Ukrainian military intelligence officers strike more than 60 Russian drone control centers and clear over 600 hectares of territory in the Sumy region of Russian forces.

items.title: Czech President denies having ambitions to become European negotiator for Ukraine
items.teaser: Czech President Petr Pavel has stated that he has no ambition to become a European negotiator aimed at ending the war in Ukraine, calling recent reports speculation.

items.title: Supermärkte: Warum Kühlregale leicht zu hacken sind
items.teaser: Angefangen hat es mit Angriffen auf Kühlsysteme in französischen Supermärkten. Inzwischen sind auch deutsche Einzelhändler betroffen. Experten rechnen mit weiteren Attacken auf Kritische Infrastruktur - und Wohnzimmer. Von S. Wolff

items.title: Exclusive: Trump envoy's push to reopen Lithuanian ports to Belarus exposes rift in Washington
items.teaser: The Trump administration's push to reopen Lithuanian ports to Belarusian potash exports is being driven by U.S. envoy John Coale and does not reflect a broader policy shift in Washington, multiple U.S. and European officials told the Kyiv Independent. items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 5: Water supply disruptions return in Kyiv, metro service temporarily suspended due to power fluctuations Death toll of Russian strike on Komyshuvakha rises to 43 as search continues Russian strikes on Ukraine’s drug supply chain leave pharmacy shelves empty Poland detains 6 suspects working

items.title: Russia has begun conscripting abducted Ukrainian children into its army – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russia has already begun recruiting some Ukrainian children it illegally deported from Ukraine into its army after they came of age during the years of war.

items.title: Ukraine und Slowakei unterzeichnen Absichtserklärung
items.teaser: Die Ukraine und die Slowakische Republik haben eine gemeinsame Absichtserklärung über Zusammenarbeit unterzeichnet, in der alle bestehenden Vereinbarungen und geplanten Projekte festgehalten werden.

items.title: Does the Oleshky ceasefire signal progress to come in Ukraine?
items.teaser: Hundreds of civilians were evacuated from the city of Oleshky after Russia and Ukraine agreed to a US-brokered ceasefire. Some observers have expressed optimism that more such humanitarian missions might follow.

items.title: Worsening power situation attributed to shifting Russian tactics
items.teaser: DTEK has explained that the worsening electricity supply situation in Ukraine is due to a change in Russian tactics and more intense attacks on the power grid.
